title: Dr.Christina Sanchez explains how cannabis kills cancer cells (MORE at cureyourowncancer.org)
summary: A short clip of molecular biologist Cristina Sanchez describing her lab research on how THC affects cancer cells. It is uploaded on a channel promoting cannabis as a cancer treatment.
why: HN commenters mostly cite it critically, as the kind of source behind cannabis-cures-cancer claims that overstate early lab results.
